'''Star Tours Flight 326''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight that traveled to [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Rafa V]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it arrived on time at Gate 1H at 0635 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 0730.
